title: Best honest configuration per encoder
description: The seed families the 2026-09-24 campaign recommends once calibration is required (docs/CAMPAIGN_REPORT_2026-09-24.md, sections 4 and 6). One entry per encoder: the headline run that is quoted as the result, and the member runs -- the same configuration retrained under a different seed -- that give every number its seed spread. This file is the single source of truth: utilities/collect_best_honest.py and cancer_sbi.evaluation.best_honest_figures both read it, and jobs/best_honest.sh takes its run list from here.

encoders.label: ArmToken-NPE
encoders.headline: AT0ens3
encoders.config: --model armtoken --tail-bound 5; AT0ens3 = equal-weight mixture of the three seeds' posteriors (jobs/ensemble.sh)
encoders.why: Highest accuracy of the campaign and calibrated; the 3-seed mixture sharpens the mean without over-widening.

encoders.label: CloneAtt-NPE
encoders.headline: R26
encoders.why: Repaired attention model (published 0.049); slightly over-confident (cov95 0.93) -- R27rc is the recalibrated variant.

encoders.label: CloneMLP-NPE
encoders.headline: R2
encoders.why: Published model was sharp because over-confident (39/44 SBC failures); R2 trades ~0.05-0.1 R2 (inside seed noise) for honest posteriors.

encoders.label: DominantClone-NPE
encoders.headline: D0
encoders.config: --require-all-trials  (same 651 test cases as the other encoders)
encoders.why: Baseline: the largest clone only. Already calibrated; no encoder repair was ever applied to DeepSet.
